messages:
tess: Quick sync  a customer asked for a "multi-tool orchestration" endpoint where a single chat call can run a mix of model invocations and external actions (HTTP calls, embedding ops, reranks). They want clear ordering controls, per-action deadlines, and a way to declare fallbacks.

miguel: Two core user stories I heard: 1) a search+rerank+embed flow in one call; 2) a doc processing pipeline: chunk->embed->index, where chunking is local and indexing can be retried.

ara: Product constraints: must not change existing chat/function calling behavior for current customers. Beta behind flag. Need to define how we surface partial success in the completion text (embedding placeholders?).

priya: API idea: POST /v1/chat/execute with body: { messages, plan: [ { name, type, input, deps: [], required: true|false, timeout_ms, retry: { attempts, backoff }, idempotent } ], global_timeout_ms }. Response: { completion, plan_results: { name: { status: success|failed|timed_out, output, error, metrics } } }

miguel: Important: plan can declare "merge_strategy" for actions that emit similar outputs (e.g., multiple embeddings): merge_strategy: first|concat|aggregate_mean|ranked_topk.

tess: For retries: only for idempotent ops. Retries respect per-action timeout and global_timeout. Non-idempotent actions can have a on_error: fallback_action or abort_flow flag.

priya: MVP runtime: support DAGs with depth <= 3, fanout <= 8. We will queue parallelizable actions and execute on available workers. Dependent actions inherit the model context from parent action where relevant.

ara: Observability: every plan_result must include tokens_consumed, latency_ms, worker_pool, and attempts. Also include correlation_id to trace across infra.

miguel: Security: actions that call external HTTP must be opt-in per org and limited by allowlists. We must redact secrets in logs.

priya: UX: docs with diagrams, sample SDK helper that maps a high-level pipeline to the plan array. Also sample fallbacks: "try reranker v2, else use v1".

tess: Launch criteria shortlist: spec PR, SDK helpers in js/python, telemetry, security review, beta flag gating + customer pilot, perf test with synthetic fanout.

ara: Edge-case notes for PR: cycles in deps => reject request with 400; duplicate names => reject; per-action sleep/long-running -> enforce global_timeout and mark timed_out; optional actions failing -> include partial result and mark overall success if any required actions succeeded.

miguel: I'll prototype scheduler; plan to reuse existing batching for embeds and model calls where possible. If an action is "embed.text", we should try to coalesce concurrent embed requests to reduce cost.

priya: Also propose rate-limiting per plan to prevent a single request from spawning too many downstream calls. Default soft limit 100 total downstream calls.

devops-bot: CI: branch feat/plan-exec started build (queued).

ara: Sounds good. Tess will open spec PR and add examples. Miguel will post prototype by EOW. Priya will work on SDK mapping helpers. Everyone add blockers by EOD.
